description_en: Creates an Elastic Accelerated Computing Instance (EAIS) and a client Elastic Container Instance (ECI), and attaches the EAIS to the ECI instance
description_zh: 创建一个弹性加速计算实例和一个客户端ECI实例，并将弹性加速计算实例绑定到ECI实例上
kebab_example: aliyun eais create-eai-eci --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --eais-type eais.ei-a6.2xlarge --vswitch-id vsw-uf6h3rbwbm90urjwa0000 --security-group-id sg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEaiEci

parameters.help_en: An idempotency parameter. It ensures request idempotence. Generate a unique value for each request. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数，保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html to view the latest Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/364379.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the EAIS instance. It can be 2 to 128 characters long. It must start with a letter. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://. It can contain numbers, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 弹性加速计算实例的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: eais_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the EAIS instance. Valid values:

eais.ei-a6.4xlarge

eais.ei-a6.2xlarge

eais.ei-a6.xlarge

eais.ei-a6.large
parameters.help_zh:
EAIS实例的规格。取值范围：

eais.ei-a6.4xlarge

eais.ei-a6.2xlarge

eais.ei-a6.xlarge

eais.ei-a6.large
parameters.name: eais_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virtual switch to which the instance belongs.

The number of IP addresses in the vSwitch CIDR block determines the maximum number of EAIS instances that can be created in this vSwitch. Plan your CIDR block settings in advance
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属的虚拟交换机ID。

交换机网段内IP的个数决定了该交换机最大可支持创建的EAIS实例个数，请务必提前规划好网段设置
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs
parameters.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The arguments for the container start command. Up to 10 arguments
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数。最多10个
fields.name: arg

fields.help_en: The container start command. Up to 20 commands. Each command can contain up to 256 characters
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令。最多20个。每个命令最多包含256个字符
fields.name: command

fields.help_en: The runtime image used by the container
fields.name: image

fields.help_en: The volumes mounted by the container
fields.name: volumes

fields.help_en: The Elastic IP (EIP) ID used by the ECI instance
fields.name: eip_id

fields.help_en: The instance type of the ECI instance
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The volumes mounted by the ECI instance
fields.name: volume

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID to which the EAIS instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. Limits:

Cannot be empty.

Supports up to 128 characters.

Cannot start with aliyun or acs:.

Cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh:
标签键。限制：

不能为空。
最多支持 128 个字符。
不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
不能包含http://和https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. Limits:

Supports up to 128 characters.

Cannot start with aliyun or acs:.

Cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh:
标签值。限制：

最多支持 128 个字符。
不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
不能包含http://和https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag list. It contains up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag
